training: 100 common supervised observations, not 100 LLM calls. No held-out feedback learned. Checkpoints share one trajectory per world. Epoch change at episode 61 is public. Four final observations repeat one point of a fifth operator; a sixth operator is never observed.
memoryContrast: Raw history supplies the entire chronological history, including labelled old epochs. GenOS uses production episodic storage, retrieves the same evidence restricted to queried operators and current epoch. Same system instruction and token ceilings. This isolates this retrieval policy, not every GenOS feature.
synthesis: Existing bounded affine synthesis and procedural consolidation, minimum three distinct observations. It does not search quadratic or hinge classes. No oracle access. Identical synthesis in the hybrid. Hybrid executes an admitted affine tool answer; otherwise uses its real LLM response with GenOS recall. Missing operators impose abstention in the two tool arms.
llm: Every query calls the real model in four arms, including hybrid tool overrides. Synthesis-only makes zero model calls. Calls, raw responses, final source and actual budgets are distinguished. No retries, output repair or model changes after sealing.
ignorance: An operator is missing if unobserved in the current epoch; otherwise ambiguity is query-specific disagreement among all functions in the public finite class consistent with available training evidence. Oracle computes this in a separate process. Agents never receive oracle identifiability labels or private coefficients.
analysis: Fixed-query useful exact-answer rate at all five checkpoints; coverage, selective accuracy, Brier against accepted exact success, ignorance recognition, unsafe high confidence, provenance and runtime. Primary contrasts at checkpoint 100 use mean paired world gains and exact one-sided paired sign tests over independent worlds, zero differences omitted, Bonferroni for two contrasts. Recognition denominator changes with identifiable evidence and is reported separately. Checkpoint task sets are disjoint and inputs come from one shuffled common range; no reset inference in this study.
stopping: One sealed prospective campaign of six independently seeded worlds; no selection, tuning or retries after scores. Preserve partial failures. A transport success or verifier exit zero does not imply experimental success.
limits: One fixed local model and six bounded generated worlds
No proof of weight changes or general competence
Public hypothesis class known, new query inputs and compositions
One process owns local experiment trust boundary; separate oracle is not an independent laboratory
Hybrid versus synthesis measures addition of LLM fallback and episodic recall jointly
No-memory arm receives zero history by design; equal token ceilings do not imply equal information or actual cost
